description: This file defines the RetryMiddleware class responsible for handling retry logic in the AWS SDK for PHP, including retry decider creation, delay calculation, and retry handling in asynchronous operations.

classes.name: RetryMiddleware
classes.description: Middleware class that manages retry logic for AWS SDK HTTP requests, supporting exponential backoff and customization.

methods.name: createDefaultDecider
methods.description: Creates a default retry decision function incorporating error codes, HTTP status codes, and curl errors with optional custom configuration.

methods.name: exponentialDelay
methods.description: Calculates an exponential backoff delay with jitter, used to determine wait times between retries.
